final: WITH account_orders AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), total_orders AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM `order`), shares AS (SELECT ao.account_id, ao.order_count, CAST(ao.order_count AS REAL) / t.total as share FROM account_orders ao CROSS JOIN total_orders t), avg_share_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares), above_avg AS (SELECT s.account_id, s.order_count, s.share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(aa.order_count) as total_orders, AVG(aa.share) as avg_share, AVG(aa.share - a.avg_share) as avg_distance_above FROM above_avg aa CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc a
